text: Good evening. I'm minding my grandson tonight, he is 3 years old. His temperature has gone up to 39.9 and he has come out in a rash on his chest and arms. I remembered about the glass test so I pressed a glass on it and the spots do fade away underneath it, they go pale. I'm still very worried, that's a high temperature for a little one and I don't want to get this wrong while his parents are away. Should I be taking him somewhere tonight or can I keep him home and watch him? I'd be grateful for a quick reply.
